fields.input: samedaydesk.seller-repair-caller-request.v1: callerId, task (40-4000 chars), origin, operation (GET /exact-path), sdk, runtime, expect.path/value, limits, observed OR explicit probeConsent

limits: probes 1-8; bodyBytes 1-65536; deadlineMs 20-5000; totalBodyBytes 1-524288; totalResponseMs 20-20000; outputBytes 512-262144; redirects 0
methodBinding: Required for seller-method-binding: caller-supplied discovering/intended/accepted methods, declaration provenance/time, body shape, retry profile, freshness, protocol. The actual received client validates these; historical repair reports remain historical.
adapterLimits: One absolute 100-30000ms deadline across source, bytes, extraction, child; aggregate source 1024-1048576 bytes; child stdout+stderr 1024-1048576 bytes; expanded archive 2MiB/128 members; 64KiB file/packet input.
outputScope: Execute writes only under --work. A referral is written only to --out. The system temp directory is not an output.
sharingExpiry: 24 hours, rechecked at later process clock
sourceAdapter: owning Neomorphic public current/download route; or explicitly supplied offline snapshot
